intro: Palestine is recognised as a state by most UN members, but it does not control its borders, and its people are governed by different authorities.

chapters.title: Who governs
text: The Palestinian Authority, led by President Mahmoud Abbas of the Fatah party, governs parts of the West Bank from Ramallah. Hamas has controlled Gaza since 2007. Israel controls borders, most of the West Bank's land and movement in and out.
No national elections have been held since 2006.

chapters.title: Recognition
text: More than 140 UN members recognise the State of Palestine; in 2024 and 2025 several more, including Spain, Ireland, Norway, the UK, France, Canada and Australia, did so.

keyTerms.meaning: The government created by the Oslo Accords.
